caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a small, vintage oil can with a cylindrical body, a spout on the left side, and a round, flat lid at the top. The can is predominantly brown with darker and lighter patches suggesting rust, wear, and shadows. The spout is angled upward and outward from the body, and a metal handle is attached near the lid. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there are no other items or details in the composition. The artist's signature, "JACK WILLIAMSON," is positioned below and slightly to the right of the oil can.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
